assets.subject: flora
assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one photorealistic asset for a serious environmental research atlas, a premium scientific visualization, not a UI screenshot. Landscape 3:2 image. Center a single anatomically natural mature prairie sunflower with a subtly turned yellow head, detailed brown seed disk, realistic broad green leaves with fine veins, and an exposed intricate root system descending through a narrow vertical cross section of dark loamy soil. The complete plant from flower to root tips should be visible, filling 85% of image height, with space around its edges for software annotations. Black navy studio void background, nearly #06121a. Photogrammetry-quality natural material, physically plausible soft cold rim lighting and neutral key light; detailed roots, soil pores and real leaf translucency. Sophisticated botanical specimen photography meets high-end scientific volume rendering. The roots branch naturally and narrow into fine root hairs; there should be no glowing magic inside the plant. This is an illustrative specimen, not a claim of a real collected measurement. No numbers, no writing, no labels, no graphic overlays, no interface, no logo. Absolutely no cartoon, vector, flat icon, plastic toy, neon rainbow, or exaggerated fantasy botany.

assets.subject: ecology
assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one photorealistic asset for a serious environmental research atlas, a premium scientific landscape visualization, not a UI screenshot. Landscape 3:2 image. A highly detailed oblique aerial 3D reconstruction of a continuous temperate Great Plains river watershed, a sinuous naturally branching river in a green valley between low rolling grassland hills, scattered riparian trees, realistic fine drainage incisions and a few rectangular agricultural fields. View from 45 degrees above. The visible terrain is a rectangular research specimen cut from the landscape; the front and right sides expose a thick soil and sediment section with realistic granular textures and gently layered muted earth tones. Extremely fine plausible topographic structure, aerial-photo-quality vegetation texture, physically correct shaded relief. The section is large and landscape-realistic, not a small toy island. Dark almost black navy #06121a void background with ample empty margins. Neutral daylight and a restrained cool rim light. No buildings, no fantasy mountains, no waterfall, no cartoon clouds. This is a schematic terrain study, not real geospatial imagery or a hydrological simulation. No writing, no numbers, no labels, no graphic overlays, no interface, no logos. Absolutely no cartoon, infographic icon, vector, low-poly terrain, plastic diorama, rainbow or glowing magic.
